content.title: Held Character Trailer | Gaze, Brush Title, One Action, Emblem
content.summary: Build identity and emotion through a portrait held longer than normal trailer cutting. Let one material stroke carry one short concept, return to a wide waiting state, release exactly one complete action, then resolve as a stable character poster with an original name and emblem.

quick_start.input_format: clearly adult original character established by three identity anchors and a held portrait + one material stroke carries one short word + environmental wide moves while character waits + exactly one full-body action releases and stops + same full character, one original name, and at most one identity line form a stable emblem poster
quick_start.recommended_input: Adult orbital botanist MARA holds in helmet close-up with a silver cheek scar, teal collar, and orange seed case. After one ink title and a waiting greenhouse wide, she completes one precise seed-cast action; a cream poster closes on MARA inside a circular leaf emblem.
required_anchors: Hold one adult character portrait with three identity anchors until one micro-action becomes salient.
Use one restrained material mark with no more than one short exact phrase.
Release exactly one committed full-body action and settle immediately afterward.
Convert the settled identity into a stable poster with one name and at most one identity line.
usage_steps: Replace the example subject, setting, and surface details with an original concept.
Keep every required anchor and Creative DNA invariant causally visible.
Choose the MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 prompt and fill only the declared variable slots.
Check duration, event order, camera continuity, sound, and anti-copy constraints before generation.
applicable_scope: Build identity and emotion through a portrait held longer than normal trailer cutting. Let one material stroke carry one short concept, return to a wide waiting state, release exactly one complete action, then resolve as a stable character poster with an original name and emblem.
Original 4–15 second concepts that can preserve every required anchor.
MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 projects that need a reusable causal video structure.
not_suitable_for: Requests that copy the source identity, setting, props, dialogue, or shot order.
Concepts that cannot show all required anchors inside the target duration.
Long-form exposition or unrelated multi-location stories without a compact causal chain.

creative_dna.mechanism: Establish one original clearly adult stylized character with at least three stable identity anchors in a held portrait that lasts long enough for one micro-action to matter. Replace the character once with a restrained brush or material mark carrying no more than one short exact phrase, then return to a wide environmental hold where weather or ambient motion continues but the adult waits. Release exactly one committed full-body action after the pause and let its path create a clean graphic bridge into a terminal emblem. End on a stable poster containing the unchanged full character, one original name and at most one short identity line. The reusable mechanism is held identity, micro-action, minimal brush-title anticipation, environmental waiting, single action release and emblematic poster closure—not the source woman, face, hair, robes, sword, words, title, ink circle, landscape, exact choreography, creator identity or timing.

invariants.rule: Hold one adult character portrait with three identity anchors until one micro-action becomes salient.
invariants.purpose: Builds attention through stillness rather than cut frequency.
invariants.ablation_failure: Immediate motion removes the retention contrast.

invariants.rule: Use one restrained material mark with no more than one short exact phrase.
invariants.purpose: Turns typography into anticipation instead of exposition.
invariants.ablation_failure: Dense copy breaks the pause rhythm.

invariants.rule: Return to a wide environment where ambient motion continues but the adult waits.
invariants.purpose: Transfers tension from face to world scale.
invariants.ablation_failure: Constant character action spends the stored energy too early.

invariants.rule: Release exactly one committed full-body action and settle immediately afterward.
invariants.purpose: Concentrates payoff into one readable event.
invariants.ablation_failure: Multiple attacks convert the mechanism into an action montage.

invariants.rule: Convert the settled identity into a stable poster with one name and at most one identity line.
invariants.purpose: Closes character and concept into a memorable emblem.
invariants.ablation_failure: Another narrative beat after the poster weakens closure.

slots.constraint: An original hierarchy of diegetic cues; no unsupported source-audio claim.

anti_copy_exclusions: the source anime adult woman, face, violet hair, robes and exact expressions
the source sword, luminous slash, rain plain, rocks and storm environment
the source FIRST LIGHT, THE TIDE TURNS, NO WITNESS, SUZURI and KEEPER OF THE QUIET HOUR wording
the source brush mark, ink circle, poster layout, action choreography and exact edit timing
the source creator identity, MiniMax H3 claim and anime identity
